➡️ Hong Kong man loses HK$13 million in fake crypto investment app scam 

🌐 A Hong Kong man in his 70s has lost more than HK$13 million ($1.67 million) after a self-described cryptocurrency investment expert contacted him through WhatsApp and directed him to a fake trading app. The latest case began when the elderly man received an unsolicited WhatsApp message from someone claiming to be a cryptocurrency investment expert from Singapore. The person introduced him to what was presented as a crypto platform offering favorable exchange rates, low fees and withdrawals at any time.

‼️ Following the instructions he received, the man opened a cryptocurrency wallet and purchased Tether (USDT) and Ethereum (ETH). He was then told to download an investment application supplied by the scammer and transfer the cryptocurrency to designated wallet addresses as investment capital.

📣 Seeing his account balance rise inside the app, the victim became less suspicious and continued sending more cryptocurrency to the wallets provided by the scammer. The fraud only became clear when he tried to withdraw his funds and was repeatedly prevented from doing so under different pretexts. By the time the victim realized the investment platform was fraudulent, his losses had exceeded HK$13 million.

🇺🇸💬🇨🇺 US military lays groundwork for possible action against Cuba, CBS News reports

CBS says it has reviewed an internal US Army message. The document does not mention Cuba, but according to several US officials it is part of "continued military planning" aimed at the island.

The US Army Reserve is checking whether it can provide Southern Command with military police, medical, engineering and logistics units within the next four months. According to the document, these forces "possibly [will be] needed in 90–120 days." Where they would go and for what operation is not specified.

Among the forces requested:
• a military police brigade
• a medical brigade and a forward surgical detachment
• an engineer battalion
• a sustainment battalion handling transport, maintenance, fuel and supply
• an expeditionary sustainment command to run logistics across a theater of operations

Earlier this year, US forces carried out reconnaissance of the seabed and maritime approaches around Cuba, while air units were placed on heightened readiness and ordered to pre-stage personnel.

In July, CBS reported that US military planners had considered several options against Cuba, including an air assault involving thousands of troops from the 101st Airborne Division.

No deployment orders have been issued so far, and US officials insist that drawing up scenarios does not mean a decision has been made.

When we created the official Handybot mascots, we didn’t want them to be simple characters. We wanted their design, personality, and structure to communicate what each service represents.

Today, meet Mino.

🤖 A SIMPLE, SOLID STRUCTURE

Mino was designed with a thick, rectangular body, giving him a solid and recognizable appearance.

His proportions are intentionally compact and robust rather than thin or overly complex. Every part of his structure has a purpose, reflecting the order, stability and precision associated with mining.

🧮 THE COLD CALCULATOR

Mino is the serious one.

He is a cold, precise calculator who constantly analyzes numbers, resources and possibilities. That’s why you’ll almost never see Mino smiling.

His expression remains serious because Mino doesn’t guess — he calculates.

📱 WHY IS HE OFTEN HOLDING AN iPad?

You may have noticed that Mino is frequently portrayed with an iPad.

It’s not just an accessory.

The iPad represents Mino’s analytical nature: he’s constantly studying data, evaluating ideas and keeping an eye on what’s happening inside Handybot Mining™.

⚙️ THE TWO DOORS ON HIS ABDOMEN

One of Mino’s most recognizable features is the pair of doors built directly into his abdomen.

💎 Left Door — Gems
Represents the entry of the Gems produced through mining.

🪙 Right Door — Bitcoin
Represents the conversion of those resources into Bitcoin.

Even Mino’s body tells the story of Handybot Mining™.

From his solid rectangular structure to his serious expression, his iPad and his two abdominal doors, every detail was designed to make Mino more than a mascot — he is a visual representation of the service itself.
